description: External, local opt-in review rules for four documented high-impact env zero CLI environment and deployment operations. Independent HOL-authored proposal; env zero does not bundle, maintain, or endorse this contribution.
name: env zero CLI command protection
saferAlternatives: Inspect the exact environment ID and `env0 context <environment-id>` before approving an infrastructure destroy.
Review `env0 deployment list --environment <environment-id>` and identify the pending deployment before canceling.
Inspect `env0 deployment logs <deployment-id>` and confirm the active deployment before aborting.
Inspect the pending plan and current approval requirement before granting deployment approval.
